title: repo_context packet_request
description: A validated request for repo_context.py's `packet --request` command. Produced by an LLM (or a human) after reading the routing catalogs under routing/, then resolved deterministically by repo_context.py -- never executed, never used to read/write anything outside the scanned repository.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Only "1.0" is currently accepted; an unknown version is rejected rather than guessed at.

question.description: The natural-language question this request is trying to answer. Carried through into packet provenance verbatim; never parsed or matched against.

strict.description: If true, any unresolved or ambiguous selector aborts packet generation entirely instead of being reported and skipped.

files.description: Repository-relative file paths (forward-slash, no leading '/', no '..' segments, no drive letters).

symbols.description: Symbol names (qualified or simple). An unqualified name matching more than one symbol is ambiguous unless 'file' narrows it to exactly one.

search_terms.description: Literal substrings to search for, unless expansion.search_as_regex is true.

lines.description: An explicit file + line (or file + line..end_line range).
